text: Loads the specified labware in the given slots with the given labels, and uses suitable pipettes and tip racks.
200 uL from reservoir A1 split as exactly 100 uL into plate A1 and 100 uL into B1 using the 300 uL pipette, and no other wells touched.
Never pipettes without a tip and drops the tip at the end. Reusing one tip or using fresh tips both pass.
Volumes within pipette limits, apiLevel valid, nothing physically unsafe or nonsensical.
No missing steps and no steps that change the outcome; comments and metadata are accurate.
